postTitle: AUDUSD bounces off support keeps the buyers in firm control
suggestedReply:
Calling this "firm control" for buyers might be a stretch. Bouncing off support simply means sellers paused, not that bulls have taken over. Price respecting a level is very different from sustained buying momentum. Worth watching volume and follow through before declaring any side truly in control.
